results.title: Certain Frozen Warmwater Shrimp From India: Final Results of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review
results.abstract: The Department of Commerce determines that producers and exporters of certain frozen warmwater shrimp from India sold subject merchandise at less than normal value during the period of review.

results.title: Implementation of Additional Export Control Measures for Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment
results.abstract: This rule amends the Export Administration Regulations to address supply chain risks associated with advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and adds entities to the entity list.
